claims.guide: CC8.0+ supports persistence hints. A contiguous window and hitRatio influence retention rather than guarantee residency. Set-aside is shared among concurrent work; excessive windows can contend. MIG disables set-aside; MPS controls its setting at server startup. These are environmental caveats, not claims that this Windows device uses MIG or MPS.
claims.gpu: Official table lists GeForce RTX5090 as compute capability12.0. This does not establish actual nonzero limits on the installed driver.
claims.context: cuCtxGetLimit reads current context configuration. CU_LIMIT_PERSISTING_L2_CACHE_SIZE is a performance hint that may be ignored/clamped. cuCtxResetPersistingL2Cache normalizes all persisting lines, not one allocation.
claims.primary_context: Primary context is unique per device and shared with runtime users in the process. Retain must be balanced by release; release does not pop current context. A separate process query cannot inspect the live server process context limit.
claims.stream: cuStreamSetAttribute affects subsequent submitted work. This alone does not prove inheritance by captured kernel nodes or retroactive modification of instantiated graph executions.
claims.graph: Kernel-node GetAttribute/SetAttribute APIs exist. Graph objects are not thread-safe. Any future policy must be verified at the graph-node/instantiation boundary; this scout does not claim automatic stream-to-graph propagation.
claims.window: CUaccessPolicyWindow describes a contiguous pointer/byte extent, bounded by the maximum-window attribute; driver alignment and architecture-dependent classification mean a nominal hitRatio is not an observed cache hit rate.

scope: Official pages read through web tool; no copied full documentation and no driver query.
